If you're aiming to ace SQL interviews, you don’t need to memorize every function or decode database textbooks.⁣
What you really need is a sharp understanding of the most commonly asked concepts - and the ability to explain them clearly.⁣
⁣
That’s exactly what this cheat sheet delivers.⁣
I’ve attached 50 essential SQL interview Q&As that cover real, practical topics - the kind interviewers actually ask.⁣
⁣
📌 What’s inside: ⁣
• Joins, Aggregates & Subqueries⁣
• Primary vs Foreign Keys⁣
• GROUP BY vs HAVING, DELETE vs TRUNCATE⁣
• Indexes, ACID properties, Transactions⁣
• Views, Triggers, Stored Procedures & more⁣
⁣
If you’ve got interviews coming up, download this PDF, review it well, and walk in with confidence. You've got this! 💪⁣
